title: Why Do Mosquitoes Buzz?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do Mosquitoes Buzz.
Some mosquitoes look for a blood meal to make eggs.
Let me show you that in 3D.
You are not their only option. Still, screens help.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Slap is allowed. Do not share that part with toddlers as a game.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Fast wingbeats make the whine.
The pictures today are a new ant world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do mosquitoes buzz.
